title: CHIME: Credit-Aware Hierarchical Memory Evolution for Long-Horizon Agentic Planning
abstract: arXiv:2609.02074v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Planning is a central capability that enables agents to decompose complex long-horizon tasks into manageable steps. Test-time search and training-based methods improve planning but incur high inference costs or require expensive training data. Self-evolving memory instead accumulates reusable experience from agent interaction outcomes into an external memory bank, so planning capability keeps improving at inference time without parameter updates. However, existing self-evolving memory methods share an inherent credit assignment problem: they rely on final task outcomes as feedback, but such outcomes conflate plan quality with execution errors and environmental factors, so the accumulated planning experience is often biased and noisy. translated_title: CHIME：面向长程智能体规划的信用感知分层记忆演化
translated_abstract: 规划是一项核心能力，使智能体能够将复杂的长程任务分解为可管理的步骤。测试时搜索和基于训练的方法可以改进规划，但会产生高昂的推理成本或需要昂贵的训练数据。自演化记忆则将智能体交互结果中的可复用经验积累到外部记忆库中，使规划能力在推理时无需参数更新即可持续提升。然而，现有的自演化记忆方法存在一个固有的信用分配问题：它们依赖最终任务结果作为反馈，但这类结果将规划质量与执行错误和环境因素混杂在一起，因此积累的规划经验往往存在偏差和噪声。为解决这一问题，我们提出了信用感知分层记忆演化，这是一种自演化记忆框架，它维护相互独立的规划库和执行库，并遵循属性归因……
tldr: 提出CHIME框架，通过维护独立的规划库与执行库并进行信用感知的分层记忆演化，解决了自演化记忆中因最终任务结果混杂执行错误与环境因素而导致的经验偏差和噪声问题。
en_tdlr: CHIME proposes a credit-aware hierarchical memory evolution framework that maintains separate planning and execution banks to address the bias and noise in self-evolving memory caused by conflating plan quality with execution errors and environmental factors.
